title: General Motors, LLC: SECOND ROW SAFETY BELT INTERFERENCE (207,210 affected)

IF SUFFICIENT FORCE IS APPLIED, THE BUCKLE COVER COULD BE PUSHED DOWN THE STRAP, EXPOSING AND PARTIALLY DEPRESSING THE RED RELEASE BUTTON.

title: WEBASTO PRODUCT NORTH AMERICA, INC.: SUNROOF SEPARATION (292,867 affected)

title: Ford Motor Company: REAR AXLE CRACKING (492,650 affected)
